WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM side_counts
)
SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(sc.order_count - ac.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM side_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE sc.order_count > ac.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: Each side represented among matched orders is included when calculating the average across sides.
